query:
SELECT 
  s.id as sponsorId,
  s.companyName,
  COUNT(m.id) as meetingCount,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.attendeeId) as uniqueDelegates
FROM meetings m
LEFT JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
GROUP BY m.sponsorId, s.companyName;
